sentences.en: Many groups of immigrants have been assimilated into American society.
sentences.zh: 许多移民群体已经融入了美国社会。

sentences.en: The Vandals settled and eventually assimilated into the Berber populations.
sentences.zh: 汪达尔人定居下来，并最终与柏柏尔人群体同化。

sentences.en: The weak easily assimilate the opinions of the strong.
sentences.zh: 弱者容易接受强者的观点。

senses.zh: 吸收；使同化；把…比作；使相似

mnemonic: 词根记忆：as（加强）+simil（相类似）+ ate（使…）→使成为一样→使同化
